links.label: About Greyhound Australia
links.description: Company history spanning over 100 years. Founded in 1928 by AR Penfold in Toowoomba. Merged with Pioneer, McCafferty's and Bus Australia. Officially became Greyhound Australia in 2004. Operates 180+ stops across Australia's mainland states.

links.label: Network Map
links.description: Interactive map showing all 180+ bus stops nationwide covering city, coast and country routes

links.label: Contact Us

links.label: Travel Passes Overview
links.description: Unlimited travel passes valid for 12 months from purchase. Choose between National and East Coast options

links.label: National Whimit Pass
links.description: From $449 for 15-120 travel days. Unlimited travel to any of 180+ stops on Australia's largest coach network. Travel in any direction on any route

links.label: East Coast Whimit Pass
links.description: From $309 for 7-45 travel days. Unlimited travel between Melbourne and Cairns on East Coast services

links.label: How to Book
links.description: Book online at greyhound.com.au with no booking fee, by phone 1300 473 946 with $5 fee, at travel centres with $5 fee, through accredited agents, or directly with driver with $5 fee

links.label: Payment Options
links.description: Credit card including Visa and Mastercard, PayPal, Zip. SSL encryption for online security

links.label: Seat Selection
links.description: Select your seat when booking subject to availability. View seat map online

links.label: Manage Booking
links.description: Change trips online up to 1 hour before departure or call centre up to 15 minutes before. Use 8-digit booking number

links.label: Tickets Available
links.description: Bookings available 12 months in advance

links.label: Compare Fares
links.description: Three fare tiers including Early Bird with lowest price and no changes, Advantage with changes up to 24 hours before, Flexible with changes up to 15 minutes before and refundable with Travel Sure add-on.

links.label: Discounts and Concessions
links.description: Children 3-14 years get 17.5% off. Infants 0-2 years nursed free or seated 50% off. Seniors, pensioners, veterans, health care card holders get 10% off. Students with valid ISIC get 10% off. Return trips get 5% off. Carers who are accompanying passengers over 15 who do not meet independent travel conditions get 50% off. Chaperones for school-aged children get 50% off

links.label: Cancellation Policy
links.description: Contact call centre 1300 473 946 to cancel. Early Bird and Advantage fares non-refundable. Flexible fares refundable with Travel Sure add-on

links.label: Frequently Asked Questions
links.description: Comprehensive answers on booking, baggage, travel assistance, onboard services

links.label: Timetables
links.description: Service schedules for all routes

links.label: Coach Tracker
links.description: Real-time GPS tracking of your bus. View live location and estimated arrival times

links.label: Service Updates
links.description: Current delays and service disruptions

links.label: Get You There Guarantee
links.description: If service delayed 2 or more hours due to mechanical fault or late arrival and departure, your next trip is free

links.label: Coach Features
links.description: Modern air-conditioned coaches with reclining leather seats, free WiFi on East Coast services in Telstra areas, USB charging ports, onboard restroom. Some coaches have tray tables, and water fountain.

links.label: Baggage Allowance
links.description: 2 checked bags maximum 20kg each, plus 1 hand luggage maximum 8kg. Additional bags $10 each with maximum 2 extra bags

links.label: Before You Travel
links.description: Arrive 20 minutes before departure. Present ticket on mobile device or printed copy, or provide booking number with photo ID. Coach will not wait if you are late

links.label: Children Travel
links.description: Children under 15 must be accompanied by parent, guardian or chaperone aged 15 or older. No unaccompanied minors permitted

links.label: Connecting Services
links.description: Allow minimum 30 minutes between connections. Contact call centre 1300 473 946 if missed connection due to Greyhound delay

links.label: Meal Stops
links.description: Longer trips include meal break stops lasting 15-30 minutes. Food available for purchase at stops. Check timetable for break locations

links.label: Accessibility
links.description: Contact customer service 1300 473 946 before travel to arrange assistance. Carers receive discounted fare at 50% off standard adult fare

links.label: Easy Access Services
links.description: Progressive rollout of Easy Access coaches with wheelchair lifts on nominated services

links.label: Account Dashboard
links.description: Free account to manage bookings, view booking history, add trips in real-time, update contact information

links.label: Password Reset
links.description: Reset forgotten password via email

links.label: Greyhound Rewards
links.description: Earn G-DOLLARS for every ticket purchase. Redeem on next trip or save for 12 months. G-Wallet accessible through My Greyhound account

links.label: Greyhound Freight
links.description: Delivers 220,000 plus parcels annually across Australia. Uses available space in passenger coach network plus freight depots and agents
